archetype: Neo-Brutalist Pop (Custom hybrid of Swiss High-Contrast & Pastel Soft)
design_philosophy: A bold, tactile, high-contrast 'anti-design' super-app that avoids the generic SaaS aesthetic. Uses strong black borders, solid drop shadows, and expressive typography to create distinct identities for its 4 core modules (VoIP, Money, Market, Community) while keeping them united under one aggressive, fun design language.

rules: NO INTER allowed under any circumstances.
Headings must use tracking-tighter and leading-none.
Overlines/labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, with tracking-[0.2em].
Wallet balances use massive fluid typography (text-5xl md:text-7xl).
Keep a heavy weight contrast: Use font-black for module titles and font-medium for body.

navigation.desktop: Left-side navigation bar (w-20 md:w-64) with high-contrast icon buttons. Active state uses module's accent color.
navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar with 5 tabs (Home, Calls, Wallet, Market, Community). Top border is border-t-2 border-black. Active icon fills with accent color.

component_guidelines.buttons: Thick 2px black borders, solid accent background colors, hard 4px black shadow. On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow increases. On active/click: translate-y-1, shadow goes to 0.
component_guidelines.cards: White or specific accent backgrounds, 2px black borders, solid drop shadows. Padding p-6 or p-8. No soft/blurry drop shadows anywhere.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn UI overrides: border-2 border-black focus:ring-0 focus:border-black rounded-xl bg-white h-12 text-black placeholder:text-gray-500.
component_guidelines.tabs: Blocky, separated pill tabs. Active tab gets a bright accent background (e.g., #FF90E8) and 2px black border with shadow.
component_guidelines.avatars: Circular or rounded-xl with 2px solid black border. Size varies from w-10 (feed) to w-24 (profile).

key_screens.dashboard_home: The 'Super Hub'. Bento-style grid. Massive 'Welcome' header. Quick-access modules: Wallet Balance (green card), Recent Calls (blue card), Top Market Item (pink card), Latest Community Post (yellow card).
key_screens.wallet_money: Centralized giant balance in Cabinet Grotesk. Large 50/50 split buttons for 'Send' and 'Request'. Transaction history list below with distinct + (Green) / - (Black) amounts.
key_screens.calling_voip: Clean oversized dialpad with circular keys, thick borders, and hover states. High-contrast bold numbers. Visual contact list with status indicators (green dots).
key_screens.marketplace: Masonry or grid layout (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Product images sit inside 2px bordered containers. High-contrast price pills overlaid on top-right of images.
key_screens.community_feed: Feed-style vertical layout. Post cards with bold user names. Upvote/downvote buttons use bold Phosphor icons. Clear dividers (border-b-2 border-black) between comments.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Elements scale up slightly or translate-y-[-4px], hard shadow distance increases.
motion_and_interactions.active: Elements push down (translate-y-[4px]), shadow reduces to 0px, mimicking physical retro buttons.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, snappy, mechanical transitions (duration-150 ease-out). No slow fades.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='wallet-send-button', data-testid='dialpad-button-5').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 minimum contrast. Dark text on bright pastel accents guarantees high visibility.
